metadata.title: [Bugfix][SM70] Indexer: write the cuBLAS prefill score tile in fp32
metadata.body:
## Purpose

Fixes #1327.

**The bug.** On SM70, `_prefill_logits_cublas` scores prefill queries against index keys that are missing their per-key scale. Without it, e4m3 values reach 448, so a single 128-wide q . k can exceed fp16's 65504. The GEMM wrote an fp16 score tile, which overflowed to `inf`. Where the mixed-sign head weights then summed `+inf` and `-inf` in the epilogue, the result was `NaN`.

On GLM-5.3-Flash, about 20-25% of the valid layer-3 scores of a 2.8K-token prompt were non-finite. That corrupted top-k pool selection for every prompt longer than `index_topk`. Measurements are in #1327.

**The fix.** This PR writes the tile in fp32 (`torch.mm(..., out_dtype=torch.float32)`), and `indexer_prefill_tile_mb` now budgets 4 bytes per score. The epilogue already loads scores with `.to(tl.float32)`, so it is unchanged. Two comments that described the fp16 tile are updated.

## Test Plan

- `python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q tests/kernels/test_deepseek_v4_sm70_indexer.py` on one V100-SXM2-32GB.
  - Image: a 1Cat build at `c59b3c4`. Its `vllm/models/deepseek_v4/sm70/indexer.py` is byte-identical to `main` at `4d57473db`.
  - This branch's `indexer.py` and test file are mounted over the image's copies. pytest 7.4.4 is on `PYTHONPATH`.
- I ran the same file against the unchanged `main` `indexer.py`, to show that the new test catches the bug.
- `ruff` 0.14.0 (`check` and `format --check`) and `typos` 1.43.5 on both changed files.

New test: `test_prefill_cublas_scores_survive_unscaled_key_magnitudes`.
- **Inputs:** half the keys are the e4m3 maximum (448, scale 2^-8), and two query heads are 2.0. That gives q . k = 114688 before scaling, against heads weighted +1 and -1.
- **Asserts:** the scores are finite and match the fp32 reference.

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SM70 indexer prefill, cuBLAS route (`_prefill_logits_cublas`) | E4M3 index keys, fp16 queries | prefill seeing > `index_topk` keys; `indexer_prefill_cublas` on (default); SM70 | Same route; the GEMM output is now fp32. Triton prefill and every decode route unchanged | executed (unit test, V100); measured (GLM-5.3-Flash TP4 end to end, #1327) | DeepSeek-V4 end to end; SM75 |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

This is a correctness fix; route selection does not change.

- **Default enabled or opt-in:** default; no new switch.
- **Required CLI options and environment switches:** none.
- **KV cache dtype used for the benchmark:** fp8 (E4M3).
- **Wheel SHA or source commit:**
  - Unit test: 1Cat `c59b3c4` image plus this branch's `indexer.py`.
  - End to end: philbert440/glm-5.3-v100 card build (`ec60883ad` + GLM PR stack), with this same change applied to its copy of the function.
- **PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used:**
  - Unit test: source overlay of `indexer.py` and the test file; host pytest on `PYTHONPATH`.
  - End to end: source overlay of `indexer.py`, plus the local patches listed in #1327.
- **User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence:** see Test Result.
- **Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons:** unchanged.
- **Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility:** unchanged. `indexer_prefill_tile_mb` keeps its meaning as a MiB cap, so a tile now holds half as many keys.
- **New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check:** none.
- **Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows:** none.
- **SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after:** unchanged.

## Test Result

Unit tests, one V100:

```
unchanged main indexer.py: 1 failed, 26 passed
  FAILED test_prefill_cublas_scores_survive_unscaled_key_magnitudes
  (at `assert torch.isfinite(actual).all()`)
this branch:               27 passed
```

`ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `typos` all pass.

Function timing. One V100, 2304 queries x 32 heads x 128, CUDA-event mean:

| keys | fp16 tile (`main`) | fp32 tile (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| 3,000 | 3.83 ms | 2.92 ms |
| 12,000 | 13.62 ms | 11.25 ms |
| 32,000 | 35.99 ms | 29.38 ms |

End to end. GLM-5.3-Flash on 4x V100, TP4, same seeded prompts.
- These runs also sort each row's `top_k_per_row_prefill` picks (#1327). That sort changes only summation order, not which pools are selected.
- The prefill numbers include the sort.

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| find 1 of 8 codes in natural text, ~26K / ~54K / ~92K tokens | 2/4, 1/4, 0/4 | 4/4, 4/4, 4/4 |
| record lookup, 12-30K tokens | 18/24 | 24/24 |
| prefill tok/s, 15-16K tokens | 2,148 | 2,125 |
| prefill tok/s, 48-50K tokens | 2,060 | 2,052 |

## Notes

- **Not a duplicate.** I searched open and closed PRs and issues for `_prefill_logits_cublas`, "indexer overflow", "indexer fp32 prefill" and "indexer score tile". None changes this route's output dtype. #1222 changed the decode cuBLAS indexer, not prefill.
- **AI assistance** was used to find this bug, write the change and the test, and run the measurements above.

---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [x] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [x] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [ ] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model.
</details>
